module_summary: Traffic-light controller: a 2-bit FSM cycles red/green/yellow via next-light registers, while a reloadable down-counter times each phase and shortens green on pass_request.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Controller state (idle/red/yellow/green) driving the next-light registers.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Phase timer reloaded 60/5/10 on light change, decremented, steers FSM transitions.

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Red light output registered from p_red; falling edge reloads cnt.

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Yellow light output registered from p_yellow; falling edge reloads cnt.

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Green light output; enables pass_request shortening and reloads cnt.

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Pedestrian request shortening remaining green time to 10 cycles.

anchors.name: p_red
anchors.why: FSM-decoded next red value; p_yellow/p_green are twins.

groups.name: light_fsm
groups.description: State machine producing next-light values per phase.

groups.name: phase_timer
groups.description: Down-counter reloaded per light, exposed on clock output.

groups.name: light_outputs
groups.description: Registered light outputs one cycle after next-light registers.
